turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, the party's at three and I just realised I forgot party bags.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: There's still time. Do you want a quick shop run for small toys, or skip bags and give each kid a slice of cake to take home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Daniel something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you going to keep playing music while I'm studying?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I can put headphones on if it bothers you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It kind of does, yeah. I've read this page about four times now.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fair enough. Want me to make you a tea while I'm up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, do you still have my umbrella?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's in the hallway, by the boots.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Before three o'clock, are we shopping or wrapping cake?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll do the shop run, it's only five minutes away.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Go for it. Bubbles and stickers are cheap and every kid likes them.
